archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL VALORANT ESPORTS

typesetting_rules: H1 and H2 use uppercase tactical style with tracking-wide font-black
Sensitivity, reaction time ms, accuracy % use Geist Mono in Sky Blue (#38BDF8)
Section overlines use tracking-[0.25em] uppercase text-xs text-[#FF4655]
Body copy remains DM Sans with relaxed leading and APCA compliant contrast

entry_surfaces./: tactical full-width navbar with Workshop/Records/Settings tabs + left rail with Favorites/Editor/Updates, central hero map selector bento grid and quick start cards
entry_surfaces./game: full-viewport 3D Three.js canvas with HUD overlays (minimap top-left, timer/score top, ammo bottom-right, health/armor bottom-left)
entry_surfaces./editor: 3D flight placement viewport with right-side collapsible tactical inspector panel and floating toolbelt

grids_and_layouts.app_shell: fixed tactical topbar (h-16) + left tactical icon-rail (w-16 md:w-20) + scrollable main content stage (bg-[#0B1015])
grids_and_layouts.workshop_grid: mode_a_tetris_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 with filter pill bar on top
grids_and_layouts.buy_menu_layout: Valorant in-game 6-column tactical weapon matrix (Sidearms, SMGs, Shotguns, Rifles, Snipers, Heavy + Shields) + right weapon spec inspector (damage falloff curve, spray, viewmodel adjustments)
grids_and_layouts.records_dashboard: bento grid: high level stats row (accuracy, headshot %, reaction time, total rounds) + progress charts + scenario history table
grids_and_layouts.settings_layout: 2-column master-detail: left categorized tabs with search box, center settings fields with live sensitivity 1:1 calculator, right live interactive crosshair and visualizer preview panel

visual_enhancers.corner_cut_panels: polygon-clipped or chamfered sharp border tactical cards with 1px border-[#223142] and hover:border-[#FF4655]
visual_enhancers.crosshair_preview: dynamic SVG rendering live crosshair with inner/outer lines, dot, outline, firing error, and color pickers
visual_enhancers.map_cards: 16:9 tactical map cards with map banner, badge overlay for difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard), high score, and instant play trigger
visual_enhancers.minimap_radar: 2D canvas overlay drawing player direction cone, bots, spike site, and radar sweep line

maps.description: Tactical tech arena interior representing Ascent / Haven practice environment
Esports arena night stage lighting for Range shooting arena
Layered dark angular geometric facets for tactical background panels
Tactical red kinetic curve lines on deep black background

motion.tab_switch: framer-motion layoutId pill underline or sliding indicator
motion.hitmarker_anim: scale-up and quick fade out (150ms) on crosshair with hit sound
motion.kill_banner: tactical skull emblem slide-up with red strobe outline and sound

accessibility.contrast_standards: All text complies with WCAG AA / APCA standards on dark navy surfaces (#0B1015, #121921, #18222D).
accessibility.colorblind_modes: Crosshair and target colors support Cyan, Yellow, Green, Magenta, and White alternatives with high-contrast outlines.
accessibility.testing_ids: All interactive elements, buttons, weapon cards, mode filters, sensitivity inputs, and score cards must have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Three.js packages if needed: yarn add three @types/three

UI Theme is strictly dark navy-black (#0B1015) with Valorant Red (#FF4655) primary action accents, sky blue (#38BDF8) for sensitivity values and key telemetry numbers, and crisp 1px borders (#223142).
Implement full dual-language support: Turkish (primary default per user spec) and English (persisted toggle in navbar).
Implement 1:1 Valorant sensitivity formula (yaw = 0.07 deg/count or 0.00122173 radians per count), supporting mouse sensitivity, ADS multiplier, and Scope multiplier.
Deliver rich built-in maps & scenarios (Range, Ascent Pre-aim, Haven Angle Hold, Bind Spike Defense, Breeze Micro-Flicks, Icebox Strafe Bots, Split Gridshot).
Ensure Buy Menu (B key) contains all Valorant weapons (Classic, Ghost, Sheriff, Spectre, Vandal, Phantom, Operator, etc.) and shields with instantaneous equip and recoil/damage stat inspection.
Add audio synthesis (Web Audio API) for hit sounds, headshot 'dink' sounds, gunshots, and kill sounds without relying on missing external files.
Provide responsive desktop-first layout for 1920x1080 and 1366x768 targets with zero horizontal overflow.
